screened_contracts.name: True out-of-core native training contract
screened_contracts.idea: A future learner consumes external row streams with a bounded number of passes and O(P*B+S*K) resident learned state, independent of N, including preprocessing, validation and all heads. Approximation and changed training are explicit; no bitwise-equivalence promise.
screened_contracts.novelty: Different data-access/statistical contract from staging dense arrays or recomputing an exact in-memory head. X055 streaming quantization and X005 sufficient statistics are already catalogued; a complete new mechanism/proof is NOT supplied by this audit.
screened_contracts.upside: Support genuinely larger-than-RAM tabular inputs; usefulness does not require beating every booster on small IID panels.
screened_contracts.risk_detail: Stable codes, target-dependent discovery and repeated residual access may require N-sized state or too many passes. Approximation may discard the native advantage.
screened_contracts.cost_detail: First source/lifetime proof 1-2 analyst days, zero fits. Conditional pilot6 controlled workloads x2 orders, one process <=6threads, <=16GiB target/20GiB hard stop; projected2-5hours, not measured.
screened_contracts.falsification: BEFORE any learner: account every persistent/temporary array and disk pass for an explicit bounded-state algorithm. Reject if any full N-vector/raw matrix remains resident, stable code remapping is unproved, or passes grow with N. Only if that proof and real demand exist: <=6datasets x2 frozen orders, N10k/100k/500k, resident growth<=10% at fixed P/S/K, <=3full passes, no hidden rescan; compare fixed quality/cost against in-memory Base. Reject >1%binary AUC or >3%relative RMSE harm, or unbounded memory. No test-based exception.
screened_contracts.round79_worthy: An actual distinct bounded-state principle/proof, strong source-balanced development, independent transfer, acceptable tails and measured whole-fit cost; changing chunk/cache/dtype is disqualifying.
screened_contracts.score_scope: EDITORIAL_NOT_EMPIRICAL; novelty relative to tested contract, not world-first claim

screened_contracts.name: Observed-environment risk objective
screened_contracts.idea: Use provider-defined site/person/time-environment membership during training to target worst-environment coded predictive risk, rather than optimizing only random-row pooled risk. Environment identity is exogenous, not inferred from target/test or deterministic current codes.
screened_contracts.novelty: Changes available information and estimand. Different from R67 code-derived context assignment, validation safety, scalar calibration and local support weighting. Robust losses X001/X002 and invariance X060 are known prior motifs; no new objective is claimed discovered here.
screened_contracts.upside: Potentially improve explicit unseen-environment reliability when pooled IID metrics hide a reproducible environment-specific failure; no promise of universal IID quality gain.
screened_contracts.risk_detail: No dominant shift cause identified; few independent environments or invalid invariance can cause negative transfer. Group-aware evaluation alone is product qualification, not a new learner.
screened_contracts.cost_detail: Metadata/provenance audit0.5-1day, zero fits. Conditional <=6sources x2 group/time-disjoint splits with fixed objective; about1-3hours after data preparation, estimate only.
screened_contracts.falsification: First reuse predictions and provider metadata, without fit: identify >=3independent environments/source and a reproducible material pooled-vs-excluded-environment failure in at least4/6sources, with labels aligned and missing group IDs disclosed. If absent, stop. A later separately authorized fixed-objective pilot <=6sources x2splits must improve worst-environment proper loss>=5% on >=4/6, pooled loss worsening<=1%, no source worsening>5%, complete fit<=2xBase. No group selection from test and no learned post-hoc safety.
screened_contracts.round79_worthy: A specified train-only risk principle with valid exogenous environments, positive matched witness, independent environments/sources, acceptable pooled/tail downside and costs. Reweighting existing recipes without the witness is insufficient.
screened_contracts.score_scope: EDITORIAL_NOT_EMPIRICAL; novelty relative to tested contract, not world-first claim
